question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Something of monstrous size or power
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4 i.e. Behemoth.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] 

**__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"Something of monstrous size or power"** refers to an entity that is extraordinarily large and powerful.
